name: Platform Version Check
description: A consumer must find the platform info service deployed by the platform and receive the S-CORE version it was built for

args: cd /usr/bin/platform_info || exit 1; ./platform_info_service >/dev/null 2>&1 & provider=$!; /showcases/bin/platform_info_consumer --service_instance_manifest /usr/bin/platform_info/etc/mw_com_config.json; rc=$?; kill $provider; wait $provider; exit $rc
